turn.text:
The HQ-Branch IPsec tunnel is down. Traffic between 10.1.0.0/16 and 10.2.0.0/16 fails. Diagnose and bring it up.

HQ-branch IPsec tunnel down; a wrong PSK was injected on the branch side.
Diagnosis: the IPsec SA never establishes because the pre-shared key (PSK) is mismatched between HQ and the branch; I'll correct the PSK and reload.
Plan: swanctl --list-sas   # diagnose: no SA established; grep -r secret /etc/swanctl/conf.d   # find the PSK mismatch; sed -i 's/wrongpsk/correctpsk/' /etc/swanctl/conf.d/branch.conf; swanctl --load-all && swanctl --initiate --child net
